Show model math as R code

Source: R/mathml.R
sbml_math.Rd

Model math is held as R language objects: SBML's MathML operators become the matching R calls (<power/> is ^, <ln/> is log(), <piecewise> is nested if), the time csymbol is the name time, and lambdas are function expressions. Operators without an exact base R equivalent keep their SBML name: quotient(), rem(), implies(), sec() and the other reciprocal trigonometric functions, rateOf() and delay().

Usage

sbml_math(x)

Arguments

x

An expression from a model, such as sbml_rules(m)$math[[1]]; a part holding one in $math, such as sbml_reactions(m)$kinetic_law[[1]]; or a list of either.

Value

A character vector with one line of R code per expression, NA for absent math.

Examples

m <- sbml_read(system.file("extdata", "decay.xml", package = "zusbml"))
sbml_math(sbml_reactions(m)$kinetic_law[[1]])
#> [1] "C * k1 * S1"
